product: DeepSeek V4 Flash W4A8, 8x910B3, DP1TP8, c12, DSpark7
actual_path: AscendDSparkProposer inherits eager llm_base_proposer._propose/_run_merged_draft; DirectDSparkHandoff rejects use_cuda_graph. Step3p5 is not this path.

segments.name: context_kv_prepare
segments.state: dynamic target hidden, token/position and KV group slot writes; not pure replay

segments.name: draft_forward
segments.state: three borrowed DSpark layers, attention and KV state; needs full same-state validation

segments.name: lmhead
segments.state: depends on target and draft forward outputs; TP collectives may occur

segments.name: markov_tail
segments.boundary: seed buffer copy then seven sequential markov_embed -> markov_bias -> logits.add_ -> argmax -> next token
segments.state: fixed B12 K7; no attention metadata/KV writes or inter-rank communication in replicated Markov head; logits are mutated in place and must be refreshed on every replay

inference: Separate cohorts and asynchronous overlap prevent subtracting Host CPU from cycle time or treating the stage-sum as a strict bound. The fixed Markov tail is the smallest correctness-contained replay candidate, but its exposed fraction is unmeasured. Before implementation, Run142 must split proposer into context-KV, model, LMHead and Markov tail with Host wall/thread CPU plus NPU events and steady cadence.

review.role: read-only architecture challenge; Sol decision remains authoritative

next_action: Run142 legal eight-rank bounded subphase and NPU-event capture at four actual proposer boundaries, no device sync in timed path.
